days.summary: Cognition raised $1B at a $25B valuation on $492M ARR, signaling continued massive capital flows into AI coding tools. Snowflake signed a $6B five-year deal with AWS for AI compute, a direct signal of AWS gaining ground on chip supply against NVIDIA. OpenAI and Anthropic are confirmed to have found product-market fit per a widely-discussed analysis, while Google faces user backlash from its AI Search overhaul, with DuckDuckGo installs spiking 30%.

items.title: AI coding startup Cognition raises $1B at $25B pre-money valuation
items.summary: Cognition's $1B raise at a $25B valuation with $492M ARR shows the AI coding agent market is attracting serious capital and generating real revenue at scale.

items.title: In more good news for Amazon, Snowflake signs $6B deal with AWS for AI CPU chips
items.summary: Snowflake's $6B five-year deal with AWS for AI CPU chips is a major win for Amazon's cloud infrastructure business and a signal that hyperscaler-supplied compute is increasingly competing with NVIDIA.

items.title: I think Anthropic and OpenAI have found product-market fit
items.summary: A widely-read analysis argues OpenAI and Anthropic have achieved genuine product-market fit, with strong HN engagement suggesting broad industry agreement that AI assistant adoption is now structural.

items.title: DuckDuckGo installs are up 30% as users reject being ‘force-fed’ Google’s AI Search
items.summary: DuckDuckGo app installs spiked 30% following Google's AI-first Search overhaul at I/O 2026, showing measurable user resistance to AI-generated search results that PMs building search-dependent products should monitor.

items.title: OpenRouter more than doubles valuation to $1.3B in a year
items.summary: OpenRouter raised $113M at a $1.3B valuation with 5x usage growth in six months, confirming that multi-model routing infrastructure is becoming a critical and monetizable layer in the AI stack.

items.title: NVIDIA Vera CPU Is ‘Packing a Heavy-Hitting Punch’ Against Competition
items.summary: NVIDIA's Vera CPU is posting strong early benchmarks for agentic AI workloads, positioning NVIDIA to compete for CPU-level infrastructure spend as AI factories scale.

items.title: Meta launches Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp subscriptions, with more to come, including AI plans
items.summary: Meta is rolling out paid subscriptions globally for Instagram, Facebook, and WhatsApp under a unified 'Meta One' umbrella, representing a significant business model shift that includes AI-tier offerings.

items.title: YouTube will now automatically label AI videos
items.summary: YouTube is moving from creator self-disclosure to automatic AI-content labeling for photorealistic AI videos, setting a new platform standard that will affect AI video product launches.

items.title: The Codex feature that works while you sleep
items.summary: OpenAI's Codex '/goal' feature enables autonomous background coding tasks, a concrete product capability that PMs evaluating AI development tooling should understand.

items.title: Your SEO strategy is optimized for a search engine that no longer exists.
items.summary: Google's AI-first Search overhaul has effectively invalidated traditional SEO strategies, requiring product and marketing teams to rethink how their products appear in AI-generated search answers.
items.topic: AI Search Impact on Product Discovery
